30-second self-check

How healthy is your Instagram?

Answer honestly. This is a quick gut check, not your real score. The full audit measures 95 checks from your actual posts.

  1. Do you post at least 3 times a week, without gaps longer than a week?
  2. Do your Reels show the payoff or a bold claim in the first second?
  3. Does your bio say who you help and what to do next?
  4. Can you tell which posts brought you customers?
  5. Do you know what your top competitor does better than you?

Answer the questions to see where you stand.

Why you can trust the score

We never guess

Every check says where its answer came from. Anything we can't see publicly is left out of the score until you add it, so the number is never inflated.

0checks measured from your public posts
0checks reviewed by AI from your covers and video frames
0checks you can add from your private Insights

    Questions, answered

    Do you need my Instagram password?

    No. The audit reads public posts, comments and profile details only. You never log in or connect your account.

    Can I audit a competitor or a client?

    Yes. Any public profile works. Private accounts can't be audited.

    How accurate is the score?

    Each check shows whether it was measured, judged by AI or entered by you. Checks without data are left out rather than guessed, and the report tells you how many checks the score rests on.

    What about reach, saves and watch time?

    Instagram keeps those private. You can type them in from your Insights and the score updates straight away.

    How long does it take?

    Usually 2 to 10 minutes, depending on how many competitors you add.
